'''Turbis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was part of Imperial strike team during the events of the [[Conquest of Makeb]] acting as an armorer for fellow [[Sith Inquisitor]]s.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Turbis first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Rakata Gear vendor for the Sith Inquisitor class.<ref name="TOR" /> During a restructuring of the game's gear system in Game Update 2.0, he was changed to a Basic Gear vendor. He was later removed as a vendor and NPC in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system. Nonetheless, he remains in the game, as his character model is used as part of the background environment in the redesigned fleet areas.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
